description:
Run Select Subject on the active layer (creates a pixel selection only, no mask).

Users often say: cut out, isolate subject, select person, select object.

Use when: you need a subject selection for masking, fill, or further edits.
Do NOT use when: full background removal with mask — use photoshop_recipe_remove_background.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { selected, method } }.
Preconditions: PS ≥ 23, active document, non-Background active layer with a recognizable subject.
Side effects: replaces current selection.

document_id.description: Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. Send null to use the active document. A number activates that document before the tool runs.

sample_all_layers.description: Sample all layers for autoCutout fallback (default false)

name: photoshop_select_subject
